title: Alweda Aye Fatima Zehra ke Dilbar Alweda
body:
Alwida aye Fatima zehra ke dilbar alwida
Alwida tashna dahen aye sheh ki dukhtar alwida, alwida masoom Asghar jaane maadar alwida, alwida ek shab ki dulhan ke muqaddar alwida, chhod kar hum ko chale jaate hai Sarwar alwida
Taziya khaane hue sunsaan aye ahle aza, ahl-bait-e mustafa ab hote hain hum se juda, ab na hoga girya-o-matam na wo ah-o-buka, jaa rahe hain hind se karbal ko Sarwar alwida
Tere gham mein maut aajati ye hasrat rahgayi, karna paye haq ada kuch aye Hussain ibne Ali, hain liye aankhon mein ashk-e-gham ka nazrana sabhi, lijiye pursa hamara sheh ki qawhar alwida
Aati thi rumaal lekar majlison mein Fatima, leti thi aansoo barae baqshishe ahl-e-aza, deti jati thi duwaen ronewalon ko sada, ab wo jaati hain liye apna bhara ghar alwida
Gar bache agle baras kar payenge matam tera, warna marqad mein karenge girya-o-aah-o- buka, hai tamanna gham mein sheh ke aankh ho purnam sada, alwida aye qhafela salaare lashkar alwida, aye alamdar-e-Hussain ibne Ali tum par salaam, Qasim-o-aun-o-mohammed naazishey Hyder salaam, hum shabeeh-e-mustafa tasveere paighambar salaam, alwida Zainab ki jaan laila ke dilbar alwida, umr bhar karte rahenge sheh ka matam hum sohail, Karbala-e-gham hai dil rehta hai dil mein gham sohail, haq ada ho jaye ehsaan ka hai kis mein dam hai sohail, qhalbe sharminda se ab kehte hain rokar alwida..
